student_initialization.backbone: same ImageNet HRNet-W48 file as local baseline

teacher.A: old D/E/B/E4 flip ensemble AFTER old H4
teacher.cache_coordinates: original image grid, shared augmentation geometry with student

input.augmentation: baseline image augmentation, shared geometry with teacher and valid masks

anchor.structure: original HRDecoder operators and weights preserved; forward API must expose native F1-F4
anchor.feature_interface: retain extract_feat result before _transform_inputs; return z0, native features, HR auxiliary outputs
anchor.backbone_bn: same as baseline throughout; no late switch

detail_L.block: DWConv3x3 -> Channel-LN -> GELU -> PWConv1x1 plus identity, 64 channels

context_C.top_down: F4 up+F3 -> DW7 block; up+F2 -> DW7 block; up+F1 -> DW3 block
context_C.fine_fusion: up to shared RGB stem N, concat 64+32, 1x1 to64, Channel-LN, GELU, DW3 block
context_C.block: DWConv -> Channel-LN -> GELU -> PWConv1x1 plus identity, 64 channels

student_fusion.restore: resize final corrected logits to original shape, then sigmoid

H4.tile_memory_claim_scope: inference under no_grad only; concatenating training tiles retains autograd activations
H4.tile_boundary: clip expanded patch at real canvas edges; each conv pads only there; crop tile core
H4.loss: 0.5 valid BCEWithLogits + 0.5 valid squared-denominator Dice; numerator unsmoothed, denominator+1
H4.lr_multiplier: same global warmup and polynomial schedule as main optimizer

loss.Dice_API: probe takes logits and sigmoids exactly once; mathematical D takes probabilities
loss.teacher_GT_confidence: Y*T_j+(1-Y)*(1-T_j); may be zero at confidently wrong endpoints
loss.distillation_reduction: per image/class: 0.5 mean_valid_GT_foreground(c*KL) + 0.5 mean_valid_GT_background(c*KL), then mean active image/classes
loss.group_denominator: unweighted valid group pixel count, clamped to minimum1
loss.empty_group: zero, no renormalization of remaining group
loss.distillation_schedule: zero through1500; linear ramp to4000; hold to32000; linear decay to40000

validity.mask: valid label AND geometric source support
validity.source_support: propagate independent source ones through all geometry; reject any output interpolation support outside source

training.lr_policy: linear polynomial decay power1 min_lr0, exact baseline iteration convention
training.secondary_checkpoint_selection: best validation mIoU from complete jointly saved main/H4 checkpoints

evaluation.metric: global per-class TP/(TP+FP+FN), macro mean of EX/HE/SE/MA
evaluation.historical_baseline: 42.20 rounded report; best-val checkpoint at32000 not newly reproduced
